name: What are the signs I need a new gas line for my water heater?

mainEntity.name: What are the signs I need a new gas line for my water heater?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs you may need a new gas line for your water heater include visible corrosion or damage to the existing line, a persistent smell of natural gas, or issues with your water heater's performance such as inconsistent hot water supply. If you notice any of these indicators, it's crucial to contact a qualified professional for an inspection. Ignoring these signs can lead to safety hazards or operational failures. A professional assessment can determine if repairs or a full replacement is necessary, ensuring your system operates safely and efficiently.
acceptedAnswer.description: Signs include corrosion, gas smell, or inconsistent hot water. A professional inspection is crucial for safety and system performance.
